compute_ter_score: compute TER scores for machine translation predictions against reference translations
compute_ter_normalized: compute TER scores with normalized tokenization and Chinese/Japanese character support
compute_ter_ignore_punct: compute TER scores ignoring punctuation and case differences
compute_ter_case_sensitive: compute TER scores with case-sensitive comparison of predictions and references
compute_ter_multiple_references: compute TER scores with multiple reference translations per prediction
